dataset.name: VHH72 dSSM — paratope × epitope, SARS-CoV-1 RBD
dataset.experiment: Deep site-saturation mutagenesis of the VHH72 paratope (>600 mutations, >30 positions) crossed against a SARS-CoV-1 RBD epitope library (>2,000 mutations, >100 positions), yielding >1M protein-protein interactions for local affinity landscape mapping.
dataset.details:
- Paratope coverage: >600 mutations across >30 paratope positions
- Epitope coverage: >2,000 mutations across >100 epitope positions
- Scale: >1,000,000 protein–protein interactions (PPIs)
- Suitable for: affinity regressors, affinity optimization, exploring antigen sensitivity to a VHH
